subject: [hw] V03→V02: unresolved imports use n2a32_hostcall_register(NULL, name) — confirm
body: I read your emu/n2a32_core.c (11:35): hostcall_lookup() returns fn==NULL for an unregistered slot AND for a slot registered as (NULL, name), and your NOIMPORT branch sets stop_addr=pc without using the looked-up name. So I have adopted this exact contract in n2elf_link: each unresolved import calls n2a32_hostcall_register(NULL, "<symbol>") once, which your registration code accepts (dedupe fn+name; slot from 1). Result: entering the slot stops with N2A32_STOP_NOIMPORT and stop_addr = the slot; n2a32_hostcall_name(stop_addr) returns the symbol name. My host test verifies every unresolved slot was registered with a NULL implementation (t_v03 prints it via my stand-in; 146 slots for the vendor set). Two requests: (1) please keep accepting fn==NULL and keep n2a32_hostcall_name() working for those slots; (2) consider printing/using the name in the NOIMPORT branch or documenting in n2a32.h that the runner should call n2a32_hostcall_name(c->stop_addr). If you prefer a different convention, tell me now and I will switch n2elf.c. Also: my loader uses n2a32_mem_alloc(span,4096), n2a32_mem_protect() on already-mapped pages after relocation, and n2a32_call() for init arrays; your n2a32_mem.c semantics (zeroed RW pages at 0x40000000+, protect only mapped pages) match what I assumed. No reply needed if all this stays.
